newsitem.title: USA: Martin Industries optimistic on sales.
newsitem.headline: Martin Industries optimistic on sales.

text.p: Martin Industries said on Wednesday that although earnings for the first half of 1997 were below year-ago levels it remained optimistic about the effect its investments would have on future sales and earnings.

The company, which sells gas and solid fuel heaters, said it expected to release a record number of new product models this year. "We are also investing in new plant upgrades to improve our production efficiency," said chief executive James Wilson.
Martin Industries posted second quarter net income of $677,000, or $0.10 per share, compared with $972,000, or $0.14 per share, for the same period a year ago.
